source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "automated decision-making" OR ("automated decision making" AND (government OR public OR welfare))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"automated decision-making" OR ("automated decision making" AND (government OR public OR welfare)),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("automated decision-making" OR ("automated decision making" AND ("government" OR "public" OR "welfare")))
